newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Gwalia sees 96/97 profit, sales rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Gwalia sees 96/97 profit, sales rise.

text.p: Mineral sands miner Gwalia Consolidated Ltd said on Wednesday it expects further growth in sales and earnings for the year to June 30, 1997.
"The company is forecasting further increases in sales revenues and earnings for the current year," Gwalia said in a statement accompanying its annual results.
Gwalia reported a 26 percent rise in net profit to A$10.10 million for the year to June 30.
"Increased productivity and profit margins will also be sought in 1996/97 from the company's industrial minerals operations were demand for all products is strong," it said.

Gwalia said strong growth continues in the group's investments in listed securities, whihc at June 30, 1996, had a market value of about A$183 million, equivalent to an asset backing if about A$2.92 per share.
Gwalia Consolidated owns a 17.5 percent interest in gold miner Sons of Gwalia Ltd.
The company's shares last traded on Monday at A$3.20. They were untraded on Wednesday.
